d:
Wake up your entire body, boost your morning energy, and release stiffness with this quick 12-minute standing yoga routine. No yoga mat, special equipment, or floor work required—you can practice this sequence right next to your bed, in your living room, or at your desk.
This all-levels standing flow targets hip mobility, leg strength, spinal flexibility, and posture through gentle balance poses and deep, invigorating stretches. Perfect for busy mornings when you want a quick physical and mental reset.
What you’ll practice in this session:
Dynamic hip openers & leg balance warm-up
